source_title: 인던만 가면 사람들 성격이 왜 바뀌냐?
subtitle: 필드에선 천사, 인던 포탈 넘자마자 탱힐 귀족 돌변

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
필드에서 버프까지 주다니!
와우 사람들 진짜 천사네!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle bright outdoor meadow encounter shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal grassy turf touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, beaming newbie Human Warlock (purple spellbook tucked neatly at waist, empty hands clasped happily) sparkles with joy while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with starry belly and gold bracers claps happily beside her under a soft golden buff aura. On the right, warm smiling Night Elf Priest (gold cross staff stowed on back, bare lavender half-up hair with gold crescent tiara and zero halo or wings) waves kindly.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
뉴비 첫 인던? 긴장 마!
나만 믿고 편하게 따라와!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Human Warlock (purple hood) and her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with starry belly and gold bracers in the lower-right foreground, looking toward Orc Warrior protection tank on the left beside a glowing blue dungeon portal, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone step touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, cheerful Orc Warrior tank (1H sword sheathed at waist and sturdy steel kite shield slung on back) flashes a friendly thumbs-up and welcoming grin.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
야 흑마 어글 안 봐?!
딜 그따위로 할 거면 나가!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle dramatic mood-shift shot just inside the dungeon in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. Instantly turned into stern drill-sergeants: on the left, furious Orc Warrior protection tank wielding her 1H sword and sturdy steel kite shield leans forward snarling with fiery eyes and dark intimidation aura; on the right, icy-eyed Night Elf Priest (gold cross staff stowed on back, zero halo or wings) folds her arms smirking coldly with a menacing shadow across her forehead.

Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 82 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with zero text or speech bubbles. Shell-shocked newbie Human Warlock (purple spellbook stowed away) freezes staring forward with blank white spiral shock eyes, pale trembling cheeks, and giant cold sweat drops while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with starry belly and gold bracers clings trembling behind her shoulder.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
천민 딜러가 감히 말대꾸?
탱힐 귀족께 감사해야죠.
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile intimidation shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, haughty Night Elf Priest (gold cross staff stowed on back, zero halo or wings) tilts her chin up looking down her nose with a chilling closed-eye smile and crossed arms. On the right, deflated Human Warlock (spellbook stowed at waist) crouches gloomily hugging her knees while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with starry belly and gold bracers pats her head gently.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
파찾에 탱힐 널렸거든?
착한 뉴비랑 깰게, ㅅㄱ!
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view sassy walk-away finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon portal stone touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, fed-up Human Warlock (purple spellbook stowed at waist) marches briskly back out through the glowing blue dungeon portal waving dismissively over her shoulder while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with starry belly and gold bracers floats proudly beside her waving goodbye. On the right, stunned Orc Warrior protection tank (1H sword and sturdy steel kite shield lowered awkwardly) freezes with jaw dropped watching her leave.
